units.text: Aspose.BarCode FOSS for Python generates barcodes in Code 128, QR, Code 39, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, and UPC-E formats. It converts barcode data into PNG and SVG images using the to_png and to_svg methods, and supports custom rendering through the Renderer interface with SvgRenderer and PngRenderer implementations. The product accepts encoding options such as Code128Options, QrOptions, Code39Options, and Ean13Options to control symbology-specific behavior, and raises EncodingError, RenderingError, InvalidInputError, and SymbologyNotFoundError when input or rendering conditions are invalid.
It generates barcodes using dedicated factory functions for code128, code39, ean13, ean8, upca, upce, and qr.
It renders barcodes to SVG strings via to_svg and to PNG bytes via to_png, accepting RenderOptions to adjust scale, DPI, module width, and text display.

It customizes rendering through RenderOptions, which supports scale, DPI, module width and height, quiet zone, foreground and background color, transparent background, and text display, returning ResolvedRenderOptions after validation.
It supports custom renderer subclasses by accepting any Renderer implementation, with built-in SvgRenderer and PngRenderer provided for common output formats.

It configures symbology-specific options using Code128Options, Code39Options, Ean13Options, and QrOptions to control encoding mode, check digits, error correction level, and other symbology parameters.

It handles errors with typed exceptions including BarcodeError, EncodingError, RenderingError, InvalidInputError, and SymbologyNotFoundError to distinguish failure modes during encoding and rendering.
This example creates a Code 128 barcode for the text Hello-World and renders it as both an SVG string and a PNG byte stream.
The following workflows demonstrate generating barcodes, customizing QR options, adding check digits, and rendering to PNG or SVG formats.
Generate a QR barcode and render it to PNG bytes.
Encode a QR barcode with high error correction and automatic encoding mode.
Encode a Code 39 barcode with an added check digit.
Render a Code 128 barcode to SVG and PNG with custom options.
Render a Code 128 barcode using a dedicated SVG renderer.

The aspose_barcode_foss.Barcode class is the primary entry point: it is returned by aspose_barcode_foss.generate() and every per-symbology helper (aspose_barcode_foss.code128(), aspose_barcode_foss.qr(), and similar), and its aspose_barcode_foss.Barcode.to_svg(), aspose_barcode_foss.Barcode.to_png(), and aspose_barcode_foss.Barcode.render() methods produce the rendered output.
The aspose_barcode_foss.code128() helper returns a Barcode instance configured for Code 128, accepting aspose_barcode_foss.Code128Options that include aspose_barcode_foss.Code128EncodeMode settings.

The aspose_barcode_foss.qr() helper returns a Barcode instance configured for QR Code, accepting aspose_barcode_foss.QrOptions that include aspose_barcode_foss.QrErrorCorrectionLevel and aspose_barcode_foss.QrEncodeMode settings.
The aspose_barcode_foss.generate() function accepts a symbology name and input data, returning a Barcode instance for the requested symbology.

The aspose_barcode_foss.RenderOptions class holds user-supplied rendering options such as scale, DPI, module size, colors, and text, while aspose_barcode_foss.ResolvedRenderOptions represents the fully-resolved configuration after merging user options with symbology defaults.
The aspose_barcode_foss.code39() helper returns a Barcode instance configured for Code 39, accepting aspose_barcode_foss.Code39Options that include aspose_barcode_foss.Code39EncodeMode settings.
The aspose_barcode_foss.ean13() helper returns a Barcode instance configured for EAN-13, accepting aspose_barcode_foss.Ean13Options that include options for check-digit input.
The aspose_barcode_foss.upca() helper returns a Barcode instance configured for UPC-A, accepting aspose_barcode_foss.UpcaOptions that include options for check-digit input.

The aspose_barcode_foss.exceptions module defines aspose_barcode_foss.exceptions.BarcodeError as the base exception, with aspose_barcode_foss.exceptions.EncodingError, aspose_barcode_foss.exceptions.RenderingError, aspose_barcode_foss.exceptions.InvalidInputError, and aspose_barcode_foss.exceptions.SymbologyNotFoundError for specific failure cases.

The aspose_barcode_foss.Renderer and aspose_barcode_foss.renderers.Renderer classes define the abstract renderer interface implemented by aspose_barcode_foss.renderers.SvgRenderer, aspose_barcode_foss.renderers.PngRenderer, and aspose_barcode_foss.PdfRenderer.
It adds the full commercial rendering pipeline and broader symbology coverage on top of this FOSS API surface.
Code128EncodeMode enum lists the AUTO, CODE_A, CODE_AB, CODE_AC, CODE_B, CODE_BC and CODE_C encoding modes for Code 128 barcodes.
Code39EncodeMode enum lists the BASE and FULL_ASCII encoding modes for Code 39 barcodes.
PdfRenderer class is not implemented.
QrEncodeMode enum lists the ALPHANUMERIC, AUTO, BYTE, KANJI and NUMERIC encoding modes for QR barcodes.
Renderer class is not implemented.
SvgRenderer class renders barcodes to SVG images.
SymbologyNotFoundError class represents errors when a barcode symbology is not found.
UnsupportedCapabilityError class represents errors when a capability is unsupported.
UnsupportedFeatureError class represents errors when a feature is unsupported.
UpcaOptions class holds configuration options for UPC-A barcodes.
UpceOptions class holds configuration options for UPC-E barcodes.
aspose_barcode_foss.exceptions.BarcodeError class is the base exception for barcode-related errors.
aspose_barcode_foss.exceptions.EncodingError class represents errors that occur during barcode encoding.
aspose_barcode_foss.exceptions.InvalidInputError class represents errors caused by invalid input data.
aspose_barcode_foss.exceptions.RenderingError class represents errors that occur during barcode rendering.
aspose_barcode_foss.exceptions.SymbologyNotFoundError class represents errors when a barcode symbology is not found.
aspose_barcode_foss.exceptions.UnsupportedCapabilityError class represents errors when a capability is unsupported.
aspose_barcode_foss.exceptions.UnsupportedFeatureError class represents errors when a feature is unsupported.
aspose_barcode_foss.options.Code128EncodeMode enum lists the AUTO, CODE_A, CODE_AB, CODE_AC, CODE_B, CODE_BC and CODE_C encoding modes for Code 128 barcodes.
aspose_barcode_foss.options.Code128Options class holds configuration options for Code 128 barcodes.
aspose_barcode_foss.options.Code39EncodeMode enum lists the BASE and FULL_ASCII encoding modes for Code 39 barcodes.
aspose_barcode_foss.options.Code39Options class holds configuration options for Code 39 barcodes.
aspose_barcode_foss.options.Ean13Options class holds configuration options for EAN-13 barcodes.
aspose_barcode_foss.options.Ean8Options class holds configuration options for EAN-8 barcodes.
aspose_barcode_foss.options.EncodeOptions class holds common encoding options for barcodes.
aspose_barcode_foss.options.QrEncodeMode enum lists the ALPHANUMERIC, AUTO, BYTE, KANJI and NUMERIC encoding modes for QR barcodes.
QrOptions class holds configuration options for QR Code, including error_correction_level, version, and encoding_mode.
RenderOptions class: User-supplied rendering options.
ResolvedRenderOptions class holds resolved rendering configuration settings for barcode output.
UpcaOptions class holds configuration settings for UPCA barcode generation.
UpceOptions class holds configuration settings for UPCE barcode generation.
PdfRenderer class raises NotImplementedError when its render() method is called (PDF rendering is not implemented in this FOSS build).
PngRenderer class renders barcodes to PNG format; it is used internally by Barcode.to_png().
Renderer class is an abstract base class for renderers; direct instantiation raises NotImplementedError.
SvgRenderer class renders barcodes to SVG format.
